text:
mia: Hey team — customer is seeing a spike of 502/504s hitting the hosted embeddings endpoint since ~09:10 UTC. Happens during large bulk import (clients send ~5k items in parallel). Logs show Envoy upstream_reset / NGX 504s. sample trace id: a1b2c3d4. :eyes:

sam: Can you paste the minimal repro curl and a snippet of the upstream error logs? Also which region?

mia: eu-west-1. Repro curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","inputs":["...","..."]}'
```
Errors in edge logs: `envoy upstream reset: connection failure`, `upstream response timeout`, and a lot of `keepalive pool exhausted` entries.

infra-bot: [alert] edge-gateway.conn_pool_saturation high in eu-west-1. 1m spike at 09:12 UTC. See dashboard: https://dash.internal/edge/connpool/eu-west-1

juan: Sounds like connection window / keepalive pool exhaustion under high concurrency. Is the client closing sockets early or retrying aggressively? Any change in client parallelism lately?

mia: Customer says they recently increased parallel workers from 8 -> 64. They also switched to long requests (no chunking).

sam: That explains it. With many long-running streams the H2 connection multiplexing+keepalive pool can get pinned. Quick checks: 1) are requests streaming (server-sent tokens) or single-shot? 2) what's avg request duration?

mia: Single-shot (large payload), avg latency 1.8s normally, spikes to 12-20s during incidents.

juan: Repro steps I recommend on our side: run a small load test from eu-west using same parallelism and payload shape. Use this script to mimic: 
```bash
seq 1 64 | xargs -n1 -P64 -I{} curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @bulk.json
```
This will reproduce connpool exhaustion quickly.

sam: Short-term mitigations: 1) ask customer to reduce parallelism (e.g., 8-16), 2) chunk their payloads into smaller batches (e.g., 100-500 items), 3) add Retry-After backoff on client. We can also temporarily increase the edge keepalive pool size for eu-west  to absorb surge but let's coordinate with infra.

kevin: I can flip a temporary config flag to increase h2 connection window and keepalive pool on a small subset (canary) in eu-west. Will schedule a 10m test window if you want to try.

mia: Please do the canary, kevin. I'll ask the customer to throttle to 16 parallel until we confirm stability.

infra-bot: action created - INC-5237: edge-connpool-eu-west-canary - assigned to kevin.

kevin: Can do 09:40-09:50 UTC canary. I'll post results.

sam: Follow-up: we should add an alert for h2-stream-duration and per-tenant queue depth so we catch this before saturation. Also add a KB entry: "Embeddings bulk parallelism -> edge connpool guidance".

mia: Noted. I'll open KB draft and tag eng.

juan: One more note — logs show occasional `upstream response timeout` with 504 when connection pool is full, but 502s appear when the upstream actively resets (likely due to backend eviction). We'll correlate backend pod churn during the canary.

mia: Thanks everyone. I'll update the customer and post back after the canary. :thumbsup:
